verdict.rationale: Vercel documents automatic preview environments for testing changes before production, with separate local, preview, and production variables that can point tests at non-production backends. It also offers Vercel Sandbox microVMs for agent-generated code, and Vercel Agent uses secure sandboxes to validate changes before they reach production. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that preview or sandbox environments isolate production data by default (separation depends on per-environment variable setup, and data branching comes from the third-party Neon integration), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
